project.name: Project_1
project.description: Unity 2D platformer with player movement, fire/ice/spike reactions, dialogue, collectibles, scene flow, and UI.

nodes.name: AudioManager.cs
nodes.summary: Manages background music; gets AudioSource in Start and loops clips.

nodes.name: FollowCamera.cs
nodes.summary: 2D follow camera that smoothly tracks the player Transform in LateUpdate.

nodes.name: Parallax.cs
nodes.summary: Parallax scrolling background layers with infinite scroll and multi-axis offset.

nodes.name: ParallaxManager.cs
nodes.summary: Manages multiple Parallax layers driven by camera movement.

nodes.name: FireMove.cs
nodes.summary: Fire trap movement; switches form or triggers reactions on collision.

nodes.name: IceMove.cs
nodes.summary: Ice block trap; pushable and changes state when hitting spikes or fire.

nodes.name: JumpJumpHappy.cs
nodes.summary: Bounce platform applying burstForce upward to the player.

nodes.name: MiniGameElevator.cs
nodes.summary: Mini-game elevator with rise/return and fade transition.

nodes.name: MovingPlatform.cs
nodes.summary: Platform moving back and forth between pointA and pointB.

nodes.name: NewLevel.cs
nodes.summary: Level-transition mover that stops at stopPoint.

nodes.name: NextLevelElevator.cs
nodes.summary: Completion elevator that rises then loads the next scene.

nodes.name: PlayerHP.cs
nodes.summary: Player health; TakeDamage handles incoming damage.

nodes.name: OnFire.cs
nodes.summary: Continuous damage and flash feedback while player touches fire.

nodes.name: OnSpike.cs
nodes.summary: One-shot damage when player touches spikes.

nodes.name: PlayerMovementRe.cs
nodes.summary: Core 2D platform controller: move, jump, wall cling, ice slide, coyote time.

nodes.name: CollectibleManager.cs
nodes.summary: Collectible spawning and timer; coordinates camera focus and GameController.

nodes.name: Mossberry.cs
nodes.summary: Collectible berry; triggers CollectibleManager count and SFX.

nodes.name: FireAndIce.cs
nodes.summary: Fire–ice element reaction switching object forms.

nodes.name: FireAndIceChildTriggerRelay.cs
nodes.summary: Child trigger relay forwarding hits to FireAndIce parent.

nodes.name: PushAwayOnPlayerTrigger2D.cs
nodes.summary: Pushes object away and locks movement on player trigger.

nodes.name: BerryController.cs
nodes.summary: Batch manager for berry objects in the scene.

nodes.name: CollectCountUI.cs
nodes.summary: UI text binding for collected item count.

nodes.name: DisplayCursor.cs
nodes.summary: Shows or hides the mouse cursor.

nodes.name: GameController.cs
nodes.summary: Level test toggles; activates gameObjects and starts CollectibleManager spawning.

nodes.name: PointerScript.cs
nodes.summary: UI pointer following objects with targetTag.

nodes.name: PointerScriptArrow.cs
nodes.summary: Arrow pointer with angle offset toward target.

nodes.name: ResumeGame.cs
nodes.summary: Resumes game and closes pause menu.

nodes.name: Timer.cs
nodes.summary: Countdown timer; damages player on timeout.

nodes.name: SpikesMove.cs
nodes.summary: Moving spike trap; morphs when colliding with fire/ice.

nodes.name: DialogueSystemDefaults.cs
nodes.summary: Global dialogue defaults (type speed, margins, etc.).

nodes.name: DialogueUIController.cs
nodes.summary: Dialogue UI singleton with typewriter and segment pauses.

nodes.name: OneTimeText.cs
nodes.summary: One-shot dialogue trigger wired to DialogueUIController.

nodes.name: TileReactionOnTouch2D.cs
nodes.summary: Tilemap touch entry point for element reactions.

nodes.name: SpaceBarDisplayUI.cs
nodes.summary: Space-bar hint UI paired with ADDisplayUI.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with GameController to see how levels boot collectibles and test flow.

tour.title: Player Movement
tour.description: PlayerMovementRe implements jump, wall cling, ice slide, and coyote time.
tour.languageLesson: Unity MonoBehaviour lifecycle: Awake/Update/FixedUpdate split input vs physics.

tour.title: Health & Damage
tour.description: PlayerHP plus OnFire/OnSpike/Timer define damage sources.

tour.title: Collectibles & UI
tour.description: CollectibleManager drives berry pickup and count UI.

tour.title: Element Traps
tour.description: Fire/Ice/Spikes and Reactions implement puzzle combos.

tour.title: Scenes & Dialogue
tour.description: SceneControllerScript handles transitions; DialogueUIController shows story text.

tour.title: Camera & Parallax
tour.description: FollowCamera tracks the player; Parallax adds 2D depth.
